title: Adding funds to your teen's account
summary: Explains how to add funds to a teen’s account via domestic wire transfer (a $10.00 receiving fee), check deposits (a $12.50 returned deposit fee if a check is returned unpaid), and cashier’s checks (fee to issue is 5). Includes tips to avoid funding issues by confirming check details and informing the wire sender about the $10.00 fee.
faqs: How can I add money to my teen’s account?
What fee applies when I receive a domestic wire transfer?
What happens if a deposited check is returned unpaid—what is the returned deposit fee?
Is there a fee for issuing a cashier’s check to fund the account?
What can I do to avoid issues with check deposits or wires?
